decision.title: The Kotlin core: the JNI glue, the cleaner and the JVM test (packet )
decision.summary: The Kotlin binding's only C is one JNI glue file of three-parameter entry points, objects are closed by a PhantomReference cleaner instead of java.lang.ref.Cleaner, and a JVM test runs it.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . Packet added bindings/kotlin/ (package dev.tinyactors.sxml; the API of docs/tasks/phase-6.md, XPath half) and tools/run-kotlin-tests.sh. ( to were left free: other running packets may have claimed them.)

item.p: Glue (src/main/c/sxml_kotlin_jni.c, the only C):

Ten entry points, Java_dev_tinyactors_sxml_Native_*, each (JNIEnv *, jclass, jobject request), plus JNI_OnLoad (JNI 1.6). The version script sxml_kotlin.map exports only these. JNI's names carry a NOLINT(readability-identifier-naming).

Request classes (Native.kt): NativeRequest (processor, handle, error), ProcessorRequest, TextRequest (parse and string), CompileRequest, EvaluateRequest, SerializeRequest, ReleaseRequest, LibraryRequest. Namespaces and variables are Array<ByteArray> in pairs.

The field table is looked up when a processor is made and lives in its glue state (from the default allocator, since the resolver state precedes the processor). Each entry point needs one GetFieldID, for , to find that state.
A request's texts are copied into one block from the processor's allocator, so the failure loop also fails them.

With an exception pending (a JVM allocation), the glue makes no further JNI call, releases what it made, and returns. The resolver bridge ProcessorState.resolve(kind, uriReference, absoluteUri): Int catches the resolver's exception; its answer is left in resolverAnswer.
libsxml_kotlin.so sets sxml_host position-independent.

Deviation: no java.lang.ref.Cleaner. Android has it only from API 33, and minSdk is 24. NativeCleaner does the same over a PhantomReference, a ReferenceQueue and one daemon thread. Actions run under the processor's monitor, and close() runs the same action at once.
API choices (defaults under ):
Processor(..., failingAllocationNumber: Int = 0) is public, as in JavaScript and Swift ().
Value.serialize(options = emptyMap()) is fn:serialize (method xml); toString() and Processor.serialize(value, null) are adaptive.
CollationData.Bundled reads the class path resource dev/tinyactors/sxml/allkeys.txt. 6.6 packs it; without it, UCA falls back.
ResourceKind has all 15 kinds of sxml_resource_kind, the two Full Text kinds included (the JavaScript package lists 13).
Misuse: IllegalStateException (closed, resolver uses its processor), IllegalArgumentException (unknown feature, value of another processor, input that is not JSON-shaped, NaN).
ctest kotlin/jvm: tools/run-kotlin-tests.sh compiles src/main/kotlin and src/test/kotlin with kotlinc (only when a source is newer) and runs TestMainKt with -Xcheck:jni; a JNI warning fails the test.
Under the sanitizer presets it preloads the compiler's ASan runtime, with ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:handle_segv=0.
It is skipped (77) with the reason without JNI headers at configure time, kotlinc (SXML_KOTLINC, else PATH) or java (JAVA_HOME, else PATH). It is not registered under WASI, Android or cross builds.
Lint leaves the glue out where sxml_kotlin is not built.
Tests: 36 cases, a small named-case runner over kotlin.test (no JUnit), all passing under debug with 0 leaks.
26 have the names of test/package.test.ts, the allocation-failure loop among them.

10 are the binding's own: the task file's example, UTF-8 crossing, input conversion, close and the cleaner (4), and threads (two threads sharing a processor, parallel processors, the cleaner under the lock).
Found:
The task file's example serializes a two-item result with the JSON method, which raises SERE0023. The test expects that.

sxml_host_string accepts U+0000, although sxml_host.h says it refuses characters XML does not allow. The test checks that U+0000 crosses intact. The header or the shim should change (owner of bindings/host).
Toolchain: Kotlin 2.2.20 (kotlin-compiler-2.2.20.zip from the GitHub release, SHA-256 81f0264c...4420), OpenJDK 21.0.12, Clang 18.1.3, CMake 3.28.

For 6.5 and 6.6: 6.5 adds request classes and their fields to the table, and HandleKinds for query, stylesheet and schema. 6.6 runs the suites (packageSuites, bindingSuites) from a JUnit test, links sxml_kotlin from an Android preset (ANDROID takes jni.h from the sysroot), and adds the DUCET resource.
